jobs.description:
Are you ready to jumpstart your career in logistics with an exciting new opportunity? Arvato’s state-of-the-art warehouse in Echt is officially opening its doors, and we are looking for energetic Warehouse Employees to join our growing team from day one! In this role, you’ll enjoy a dynamic two-shift schedule, earning a competitive starting rate of €14.99 per hour, plus an extra 19% bonus for any hours worked after 7:00 PM. Best of all, you won't have to wait to see the rewards of your hard work, thanks to weekly payouts!

What we offer
- Starting salary from €14.99 to €17.84 per hour
- More experience means higher pay!
- Guaranteed 32 hours per week
- Excellent chance for a permanent contract
- Travel allowance and holiday pay
- Working at a brand new warehouse!

Who you are
As a orderpicker, it’s important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak English
- You are available immediately
- You can work at least 4 days a week
- You are able to work in a 2-shift system
- You can work in the area of Echt

What will you do
Step into an exciting, fast-paced role where your impact truly matters! As an order picker at Arvato, you’ll be at the heart of our operations, driving quality and precision every single day. No two days are ever the same here—you'll gear up for a dynamic hands-on routine selecting orders, carefully packing top-tier products, and carrying out sharp quality checks. Plus, with exciting rotations across diverse departments, you’ll master a huge variety of products and keep your workday fresh and engaging.
And when it’s time to recharge? Head over to our vibrant, fully stocked cafeteria to relax with fresh coffee, cold drinks, and a delicious selection of hot soups and sandwiches.

Where will you work
Welcome to Arvato’s brand-new, state-of-the-art warehouse in Echt! Here, you’ll dive into a vibrant, high-energy environment where no two days are the same—mastering order picking, packing, and quality checks across diverse departments alongs

There are different positions within the Outbound department. Together we'll see which role suits you best.

📦 Packing

In Packing, you make sure products are packed correctly before they are shipped.

Your tasks include:

- Checking products;
- Packing orders;
- Adding labels and documents;
- Preparing shipments for transport.

🚜 Picking (Reach Truck)

As a Reach Truck Operator, you collect products for customer orders.

Your tasks include:

- Picking orders;
- Moving products from warehouse locations;
- Operating the reach truck safely;
- Replenishing stock when needed.

No reach truck certificate yet? No problem. Olympia can help you get one.

✅ Consolidation

In Consolidation, you make sure orders are complete before they leave the warehouse.

Your tasks include:

- Checking orders;
- Combining products into complete shipments;
- Checking quantities and quality;
- Releasing orders for shipment.

✅ Salary starting from €15.00 gross per hour
✅ Shift allowances on top of your hourly wage

✅ Career growth opportunities within DHL
✅ Chance of a contract with DHL

For the Sealing & Polymer department, we are looking for an enthusiastic Prep & Finish Operator. You will join a dynamic team where quality, precision, and collaboration are key. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that products are carefully prepared and finished, meeting the highest quality standards.

As a Prep & Finish Operator, you are responsible for various activities within the production process. During the prep phase, you clean metal parts using special fluids, sandblast components to optimally prepare the surface, clean them again, and apply a primer. In addition, you work carefully, have technical insight, and have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language.
